on_composition import CoreRig

async def verify():
    repo = Path.cwd()
    git = Git(SubprocessExec(), env=dict(os.environ), timeout=30)
    head = await git.rev_parse(repo, \"HEAD\")
    status = await git.status_porcelain(repo)
    print(\"Untouched base:\", head)
    print(\"Initial worktree clean:\", status == \"\")
    assert status == \"\"
    for name in (\"chupa/triage.py\", \"chupa/driver.py\", \"CHUPA_PLAN.md\"):
        assert (repo / name).read_text() == await git._run(repo, \"show\", f\"{head}:{name}\")
    original = Driver.from_config
    captured = []
    def observe(*args, **kwargs):
        driver = original(*args, **kwargs)
        captured.append(driver)
        return driver
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix=\"chupa-serve-custody-\") as directory:
        rig = CoreRig(Path(directory))
        llm = FakeLLM([])
        with patch.object(Driver, \"from_config\", side_effect=observe):
            assert await triage.triage_pass(rig.checkout, llm) == []
        [driver] = captured
        print(\"Triage Driver shares checkout.journal:\", driver.journal is rig.checkout.journal)
        print(\"Triage Effects share checkout.journal:\", driver.effects._journal is rig.checkout.journal)
        print(\"Model and synthetic process calls:\", len(llm.requests), len(rig.exec.calls))
        assert driver.journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is driver.journal
        assert llm.requests == [] and rig.exec.calls == []
        driver.journal.close()
        rig.journal.close()
    assert await git.status_porcelain(repo) == \"\"
    print(\"No source changes or commits; worktree clean.\")

asyncio.run(verify())
